artworks.title: Sir Philip Sidney
artworks.description: The image shows a man in full plate armor standing upright. He wears a helmet with feathers, has a visible face with a mustache and beard, one hand holding a shield and the other hand on a sword hilt. He wears additional clothing, possibly a sash or scarf. The background features a sketched landscape with a town or castle, detailed architecture, rolling hills, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: James Ussher, Archbishop of Armagh
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in a bust form within an oval frame. The man has a pointed beard, mustache, short hair under a cap, and wears a detailed ruff collar. He has a calm expression and wears a dark garment with vertical lines. The oval frame is ornate with floral motifs and a crest at the top. Text appears within the frame and beneath the image.

artworks.title: Thomas Willsford, Mathematician
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man seated and facing slightly to the right. The man has a high forehead, prominent cheekbones, and an oval-shaped face. He has wavy, shoulder-length hair with a receding top. The man wears 17th-century clothing with a large white collar over a darker garment resembling robes or a cloak. He is holding a pair of spectacles delicately in his hand at chest level. The image is bordered decoratively, and the background has intricate line work. Above the portrait is a crest with a lion's face, and to the top right is a heraldic shield. Text at the top and bottom includes Latin phrases and English verses for context.

artworks.title: A Venetian Doge
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man seated and facing forward. He has a beard, mustache, and deep-set eyes. He is wearing a robe, hat, and holding a scroll. The background has a floral motif and a cartouche above his head with a lion with wings sitting on a book surrounded by light. The engraving is framed with intricate detailing.

artworks.title: A Doge of Venice
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, with a slightly turned body and his face towards the viewer. He has a long, pointed beard and mustache, with older features, and wears a decorative, domed headdress. He is clothed in a patterned robe with a high collar, buttons down the front, and holds a rolled document in his right hand. The background features a frame with scrolling foliage and decorative elements, with an emblem at the top showing a winged lion holding a book.

artworks.title: Title Plate to John Hayward, Life and Reigne of King Edward the Sixth
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a person shown from the chest upwards, centered within an oval frame. The person has delicate facial features with light-colored eyes and a neutral expression. They wear a fur-collared garment over an intricately decorated outfit, including a large chain hanging around their neck. A bonnet adorned with a feather rests slightly tilted on their head. Surrounding the oval frame are two figures in armor holding leafy garlands above the individual's head. The left figure is labeled "MAJESTY" and is depicted in Roman-like armor with a plumed helmet, while the right figure is labeled "POWER" and holds a shield. Above the central portrait is a decorative crest featuring a lion, a dragon, and a crown. The background is an intricately designed engraving with architectural elements and patterned borders containing text.

artworks.title: Title Plate to John Hayward, Life and Reigne of King Edward the Sixth
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of King Edward the Sixth. He is portrayed in a frontal position, gazing ahead with a serious expression. His features are detailed, including his youthful appearance, narrow eyes, and well-groomed hairstyle partially covered by a cap. He is dressed in regal attire with a fur collar, intricate embroidery, and a pendant. The ornate frame around him features English heraldic symbols such as a crowned lion and dragon. Beside King Edward are figures symbolizing "Majesty" and "Power," holding laurel wreaths. The background includes architectural elements, columns, a crown motif, and heraldic shields. The image resembles a historical engraving with text at the bottom providing creation and publication details.

artworks.title: Title Plate to John Hayward, Life and Reigne of King Edward the Sixth
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a young boy's bust, possibly King Edward VI, within an oval frame. He is shown facing forward with a serious expression, fine facial features, and short hair partially covered by a hat with a feather. He wears elaborate clothing including a fur-lined robe, a patterned garment, and a large jeweled pendant. Two armored female figures stand on pedestals labeled "MAJESTY" and "POWER" on either side of the portrait. They hold onto a decorative frame. Above the central figure is an ornate crest with a crowned lion and griffin, surrounded by intricate designs. The background features architectural elements like columnar structures. Text detailing the title and authorship is located below the portrait.

artworks.title: The Lady of Rochford
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a kneeling position. They are facing to the right with their hands together in a gesture of prayer. The person has delicate facial features, a calm expression, and eyes looking forward. Their hair is covered by a drape, resembling a headscarf or headdress. They wear an elaborately patterned gown with intricate details, including a large border featuring round shapes and floral motifs at the shoulders. The gown has a fur or feather-like texture at the bottom and flows down to a cushion. The background is plain, emphasizing the person's attire.

artworks.title: Augustus II, Elector of Saxony
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is seated in a slightly angled position, facing towards the left side of the frame. The man has a beard and mustache, with curly hair visible under a tall, wide-brimmed hat. He is wearing elaborate clothing, including a patterned doublet with buttons and lace trim at the collar, a cloak over one shoulder, and a chain around his neck. The man holds the hilt of a sword in his left hand. The background includes draped curtains and a column.

artworks.title: Lodovick Stuart, Duke of Richmond and Lennox
artworks.artist: Johan Barra after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with an upright posture. He has an older appearance, a large groomed beard, curly hair, and wears elaborate attire, including a robe with intricate patterns, an embellished collar, a sash with a large emblem, a sword at his waist, a hat with feathers in his left hand, and a staff in his right hand. His legs are covered with ornate stockings and shoes. The background features heavy drapery and another figure's hands on a table, suggesting an indoor setting. Text and an emblem are visible at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Bonaventura, Comte de Buquoy
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from his chest upwards, facing forward with his head turned slightly to his left. He has a curling mustache, small beard, curly hair styled back, and is dressed in a historical military outfit with decorative armor, a draped sash, and a textured ruff around his neck. He holds a baton in his right hand. The portrait is framed with ornate scrolling designs and text around and beneath the figure, likely denoting his titles and achievements. The background is filled with fine lines for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Charles, Count of Bucquoy
artworks.description: The image displays an etching of a man shown from the torso up, oriented facing slightly to his left. His facial features include a prominent mustache and a well-defined chin, with curly hair that frames his face and falls onto his neck. He is wearing an elaborate outfit that appears to be armor or a decorative garment with a wide collar. A patterned sash or scarf is draped across his shoulder. The background is plain and textured with handwritten text above and below the figure, naming him as "Charles Longevall, Count of Bucquoy." The text at the bottom provides historical context about his military career.

artworks.title: William Camden
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man from the waist up, set within an ornate oval frame. The man is seated, facing slightly to the left with a composed expression. He has a short beard and mustache, wearing traditional formal attire with a high-collared fur-lined cloak and a cap. A decorative oil lamp is to his left, and a skull and crossbones are to his right. Above the frame is a figure with a long beard and wings on top of a skull-topped staff, surrounded by geometric and heraldic designs. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: William Camden
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man within an ornate oval frame. The man has distinct facial features, with a prominent nose and a neatly trimmed beard. He wears formal clothing, including a high ruffed collar and a buttoned robe. The frame is adorned with decorative elements such as flowers and leaves. Above the portrait is an angelic figure with wings, reclining with one arm propped on a skull on a shelf. Additional symbolic elements surround the frame, including an emblem resembling a coat of arms and an illustration involving a compass and a ruler. Below the frame, there is a small plaque with an inscription in English.

artworks.title: Richard Sackville, Third Earl of Dorset
artworks.description: This print shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing us, his body slightly turned to the right. The man has light skin, a neatly styled mustache, a pointed beard, and short, curly hair. He is dressed in reflective armor made of overlapping panels connected by rivets. Above the armor, he wears a high lace ruff around his neck, and he has a fabric draped over his right shoulder. He holds a cylindrical baton or staff in his right hand. Around this portrait is a circular frame with text on it. The man's baton pokes slightly out of this frame. Above the frame is a figure of a cherub who appears to be carrying the portrait on a string, as well as the head of a goat on the right and a crowned shield on the left. Below the frame are two small vases with flowers, as well as a section of text within a swirling border. The background is gray, with a darker border around the edges of the print. The print is surrounded by a thick border of plain paper.

artworks.title: Robert Devereux, Second Earl of Essex
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a man from the waist up. He faces slightly to his left with his head turned forward. The man has a mustache, beard, curly hair, and wears a large, ornate hat with a plume. He is dressed in intricate clothing with lace detailing and holds a baton or staff in his right hand. The background is decorated with elaborate scrollwork and heraldic symbols, with Latin text providing context about the individual's identity and titles.

artworks.title: Robert Devereux, Second Earl of Essex
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of the upper torso of a man in a formal portrait pose. He is facing forward, looking slightly to his right. The man has a full beard and mustache, curly hair under a tall hat with decorations, and wears an ornate garment with intricate patterns. He holds a staff or baton in his right hand. The background features an oval frame with Latin text and decorative elements like scrolls and crests.

artworks.title: Eva Fliegen
artworks.description: The engraving depicts an upper-body portrait of a person facing forward with a serious expression. They are wearing a bonnet, a high-necked garment with a ruffled collar, and holding a small collection of flowers or herbs. The scene is framed by ornate scrollwork with a shield displaying a flower emblem at the top. The background contains intricate lines, and a piece of text on a scroll is below the figure.

artworks.title: Eva Fliegen
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, facing slightly to the side with her gaze directed at the viewer. She has a somber expression, thin lips, prominent cheekbones, and intent eyes. She wears a cap, a ruffled collar, and a textured long-sleeved garment. She holds a small bouquet of flowers. The decorative border features floral motifs and an ornate emblem of a plant at the top center. The background has a dark pattern, with an oval frame around the woman. Text appears in scrolls and on the border around the portrait.

artworks.title: Frederick Henry, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a person from the waist up. The individual is facing forward with the upper body slightly turned, holding a baton. They have facial hair and curly hair, wearing historical European aristocratic clothing with armor, a ruffled collar, and a sash. The background has a decorative frame and a coat of arms, with inscriptions detailing the individual's name and titles.

artworks.title: Frederick Henry, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body in an oval frame with ornate decorations and a coat of arms at the top. The man is slightly angled to the right, looking outward. He has a high forehead, wavy hair, and a mustache and goatee. He wears regal clothing, including a ruffled collar, a cloak, and armor with patterns, holding a staff in his right hand. The background includes decorative elements and Latin text in ribbon-like banners.

artworks.title: Frederick Henry, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a detailed face, high cheekbones, pointed mustache, and curly hair. He wears ornate armor, a ruff, and a sash. He holds a staff in his right hand. The background features intricate designs, Latin text, and a coat of arms.
